$comment: Meadow flowers (tools/content/env/plants.mjs flowerMesh). Ground cover: decorative only (no collision, no concealment), grown by the terrain's plants brush (packages/client/src/foliage.ts) and placeable as a prop. Basal leaves and stems in vertex colour (env.grass), a flower-head card per stem from the leaves atlas (env.leaf; look.card: 0 daisy, 1 buttercup, 2 clover). The variants share the plant and change the flower: white, yellow, purple. One level of detail.

notes.1: First version: replaces the Kenney flowers the plants brush grew (owner, 2026-11-05).
